name: BOOM FM
author: zvenson
description: Mini DAW on the VIBE: 8 tracks · synth drums · playable 808 bass · 4-op FM keys · OberVave analog synth · DX7 voices (.syx) · string ensemble · electric piano (tines and reeds) · tube amp · OberVave's sequencer, mixer, FX and audio tracks – native VIBE firmware
